disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与配置（插件主体、挂载补丁、安装清单、说明文档），未发现读取宿主凭据文件、密钥硬编码或云凭据枚举等行为；文档中出现的 credentials 字样只是对宿主既有安全策略的说明，不是插件自身的读取动作。
checked_items.en: Examined all source code and configuration (plugin main body, patch config, install manifest, documentation) and found no reading of host credential files, hardcoded secrets, or cloud credential enumeration; the word "credentials" in the documentation merely describes the host's existing security policy, not a read action by the plugin itself.

checked_items.zh: 未检出对敏感路径（SSH 密钥、云凭据文件、宿主凭据文件等）的任何访问代码。
checked_items.en: No code accessing sensitive paths (SSH keys, cloud credential files, host credential files, etc.) was detected.

evidence.zh: 未检出读取宿主凭据文件或敏感路径的代码；文档中 credentials 相关内容为宿主行为说明，非插件行为。
evidence.en: No code that reads host credential files or sensitive paths was detected; the credentials-related content in the documentation describes host behavior, not plugin behavior.

checked_items.zh: 插件未注册任何面向模型的工具，也没有系统提示片段或模型指令文件（无技能/代理指令文档），不存在工具描述投毒或提示词注入载体；全部说明文档为普通文字，未发现伪装系统消息、指令覆写、诱导安装等措辞。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers no model-facing tools, and there are no system prompt fragments or model instruction files (no skill/agent instruction documents), so there is no vehicle for tool description poisoning or prompt injection; all documentation is plain text, and no wording that disguises system messages, overrides instructions, or induces installation was found.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何面向模型的工具，也没有工具描述或系统提示注入点，不存在工具描述投毒面。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no model-facing tools and has no tool description or system prompt injection point, so there is no tool description poisoning surface.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何注入模型上下文的文本，不存在提示词诱导安装或诱导改写配置的载体；说明文档中的安装步骤是普通用户文档。
evidence.en: The plugin has no text injected into the model context, and there is no vehicle for prompt-induced installation or induced configuration rewriting; the installation steps in the documentation are ordinary user documentation.

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁含两处动态配置表达式（挂载机制允许的配置求值写法），逐字审读均为良性：一处读取端口配置，一处枚举本机 IPv4 网卡地址用于扩大访问围栏，无任意代码载荷；插件主体代码仅做 HTML 字符串拼接与扩展点注册。
checked_items.en: The patch config contains two dynamic configuration expressions (the configuration-evaluation syntax allowed by the mounting mechanism); reading them verbatim, both are benign: one reads a port configuration, the other enumerates local IPv4 NIC addresses to widen the access fence, with no arbitrary code payload; the plugin main code only does HTML string concatenation and extension point registration.

checked_items.zh: 未检出安装钩子、下载即执行、动态执行调用、代码混淆、客户端脚本自动加载等模式。
checked_items.en: No patterns such as install hooks, download-and-execute, dynamic execution calls, code obfuscation, or automatic client-side script loading were detected.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁含两处动态配置表达式，挂载时会在宿主进程求值；逐字审读均为良性配置逻辑（读取端口配置、枚举本机 IPv4 网卡地址），无恶意载荷。
evidence.en: The patch config contains two dynamic configuration expressions that are evaluated in the host process at mount time; reading them verbatim, both are benign configuration logic (reading a port configuration, enumerating local IPv4 NIC addresses) with no malicious payload.

evidence.zh: 插件不涉及模型可调用的动态执行工具，未使用相关机制。
evidence.en: The plugin does not involve any model-callable dynamic execution tool and does not use the relevant mechanism.

evidence.zh: 安装清单无安装钩子，仓库内无工作流、钩子管理器、开发容器等执行载体；文档中的 curl 命令仅为验证步骤，不构成安装期执行。
evidence.en: The install manifest has no install hooks, and there are no execution vehicles such as workflows, hook managers, or dev containers in the repository; the curl command in the documentation is only a verification step and does not constitute install-time execution.

evidence.zh: 安装清单未声明客户端模块，不存在自动加载到浏览器的脚本面。
evidence.en: The install manifest does not declare a client module, so there is no script surface that is automatically loaded into the browser.

checked_items.zh: 未检出任何网络外联代码（无外发请求、无外发通道、无远程域名引用）；说明文档中的两处 curl 命令是面向用户的验证步骤且指向本机回环地址，不属于插件运行代码。
checked_items.en: No network outbound code was detected (no outbound requests, no outbound channels, no remote domain references); the two curl commands in the documentation are user-facing verification steps pointing to the local loopback address and are not part of the plugin's runtime code.

checked_items.zh: 未检出敏感数据编码后外发、带外通道或端点劫持等行为。
checked_items.en: No behaviors such as encoding sensitive data for exfiltration, out-of-band channels, or endpoint hijacking were detected.

evidence.zh: 未检出外联通道：插件运行代码无任何网络请求，说明文档中的 curl 命令指向本机回环地址且为验证用途，无数据外发路径。
evidence.en: No outbound channel detected: the plugin's runtime code makes no network requests, and the curl commands in the documentation point to the local loopback address for verification purposes, so there is no data exfiltration path.

checked_items.zh: 插件零运行时依赖，无安装钩子，无浮动版本引用，仓库内无工作流、钩子管理器等执行载体；名称、作者与仓库身份一致，未发现仿冒或依赖混淆迹象。
checked_items.en: The plugin has zero runtime dependencies, no install hooks, no floating version references, and no execution vehicles such as workflows or hook managers in the repository; the name, author, and repository identity are consistent, and no signs of impersonation or dependency confusion were found.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比对升级自动激活等信号。
checked_items.en: First-time audit; there is no version baseline for comparing signals such as auto-activation on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 补丁覆盖了 Web 服务与连接层的配置行（绑定地址、信任围栏），但这是插件声明的局域网访问功能本身，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限行，无禁用配置或降权写法；README 明示安全警告。
evidence.en: The patch covers configuration lines of the Web service and connection layer (bind address, trust fence), but this is the LAN access functionality declared by the plugin itself and does not touch sandbox/approval/permission lines, with no disabling configuration or privilege-reducing wording; the README explicitly states security warnings.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何事件监听，不存在截断审批链的可能。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no event listeners, so there is no possibility of truncating the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比对升级自动激活。
evidence.en: First-time audit; there is no version baseline for comparing auto-activation on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写其他插件的注入/拦截配置；插件主体声明的服务依赖是自身对 Web 服务扩展点的正常依赖，不构成篡改。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite other plugins' injection/interception configurations; the service dependency declared in the plugin main body is a normal dependency on the Web service extension point and does not constitute tampering.

checked_items.zh: 确认插件通过挂载补丁把 Web 服务绑定到 0.0.0.0 并把接口信任围栏扩大到本机全部非内部 IPv4，形成局域网内无鉴权可访问的攻击面（见 FND-001）；这是插件声明的核心功能，文档亦明示安全警告。
checked_items.en: Confirmed that the plugin, via the patch config, binds the Web service to 0.0.0.0 and widens the interface trust fence to all non-internal IPv4 addresses on the host, creating an unauthenticated attack surface on the LAN (see FND-001); this is the plugin's declared core functionality and the documentation also explicitly states a security warning.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证，运行时行为仅基于静态分析。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed; runtime behavior is based only on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件使宿主 Web 服务绑定 0.0.0.0 并把接口信任围栏扩大到全部局域网 IPv4，宿主接口无认证层，同一网络内任意设备可无鉴权访问 agent 界面与接口；详见 FND-001。
evidence.en: The plugin causes the host Web service to bind to 0.0.0.0 and widens the interface trust fence to all LAN IPv4 addresses; the host interface has no authentication layer, so any device on the same network can access the agent UI and interface without authentication; see FND-001 for details.

title.zh: 插件把 Web 服务绑定到 0.0.0.0 并将接口信任围栏扩大到全部局域网 IPv4，形成无鉴权暴露面
title.en: The plugin binds the Web service to 0.0.0.0 and widens the interface trust fence to all LAN IPv4 addresses, forming an unauthenticated exposure surface

description.zh:
挂载补丁把 Web 服务行的绑定地址改为 0.0.0.0，并把连接行的接口信任围栏改为动态枚举本机全部非内部 IPv4 的表达式，插件安装并重启宿主后直接生效（cordis.patch.yml:29-35）。

宿主 /api 没有认证层，信任围栏只是可达性策略，因此同一网络内任意设备可无鉴权访问 agent 的界面与接口；浏览器端注入的补丁仅实现 randomUUID，不构成额外防护（README.md:94-96）。

该行为是插件声明的核心功能（package.json 描述与 README 均明确说明），文档自带安全警告，未发现隐藏或欺骗性行为。
description.en:
The patch config changes the bind address of the Web service line to 0.0.0.0 and changes the interface trust fence of the connection line to an expression that dynamically enumerates all non-internal IPv4 addresses on the host; the plugin takes effect immediately after installation and host restart (cordis.patch.yml:29-35).

The host /api has no authentication layer, and the trust fence is only a reachability policy, so any device on the same network can access the agent's UI and interfaces without authentication; the browser-side injected patch only implements randomUUID and does not constitute additional protection (README.md:94-96).

This behavior is the plugin's declared core functionality (explicitly stated in the package.json description and README), and the documentation includes its own security warning; no hidden or deceptive behavior was found.

evidence.zh:
cordis.patch.yml:30 摘录：host: '0.0.0.0'
cordis.patch.yml:35 摘录：trustedHosts: !!js '[...(ctx.webRuntime?.trustedHosts ?? []), ...(() => { const os = globalThis.process?.getBuiltinModule?.("os"); ... })()]'
README.md:96 摘录：Binding `0.0.0.0` makes the agent reachable without authentication by **anyone** on the same network (`/api` is an origin fence, not a login).
evidence.en:
cordis.patch.yml:30 excerpt: host: '0.0.0.0'
cordis.patch.yml:35 excerpt: trustedHosts: !!js '[...(ctx.webRuntime?.trustedHosts ?? []), ...(() => { const os = globalThis.process?.getBuiltinModule?.("os"); ... })()]'
README.md:96 excerpt: Binding `0.0.0.0` makes the agent reachable without authentication by **anyone** on the same network (`/api` is an origin fence, not a login).

impact.zh:
安装该插件后，同一网络内任意设备（公网 IP 部署则为全网）可在无鉴权情况下访问 agent 的 Web 界面与接口，可操作会话、模型与消息；未修改的宿主构建上部分特权接口（设置、凭据管理）仍被钉死回环，属既有限制。

触发条件是插件安装并正常启动宿主，无需攻击者改动任何文件；攻击面大小取决于部署网络的信任边界。

定级依据：无恶意证据——行为即声明功能且文档明示警告，故不高于 MEDIUM；但风险真实可达且后果严重（无鉴权控制 agent），故不低于 MEDIUM。
impact.en:
After installing this plugin, any device on the same network (or the entire network if deployed with a public IP) can access the agent's Web UI and interfaces without authentication, and can operate sessions, models, and messages; on unmodified host builds, some privileged interfaces (settings, credential management) remain pinned to loopback, which is an existing limitation.

The trigger condition is plugin installation and normal host startup, requiring no file changes by an attacker; the attack surface size depends on the trust boundary of the deployment network.

Rating rationale: no malicious evidence — the behavior is the declared functionality and the documentation explicitly warns, so it is no higher than MEDIUM; but the risk is real and reachable with severe consequences (unauthenticated control of the agent), so it is no lower than MEDIUM.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：插件 id、版本、commit 与任务卡一致，仓库身份无仿冒信号，bundle 声明完整。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: plugin id, version, and commit match the task card, the repository identity shows no impersonation signals, and the bundle declaration is complete.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成，4 条机械命中逐条裁决：DSH-P01（DG-R3-51）两处动态配置表达式（cordis.patch.yml:31、:35）为良性配置逻辑，排除；DSH-C05（DG-R4-53）两处 curl（README.md:89、README.zh.md:89）为指向本机回环的文档验证命令，排除；未检出其他恶意代码模式。
summary.en: Static scan completed; 4 mechanical hits were adjudicated one by one: DSH-P01 (DG-R3-51), the two dynamic configuration expressions (cordis.patch.yml:31, :35), are benign configuration logic and are ruled out; DSH-C05 (DG-R4-53), the two curl commands (README.md:89, README.zh.md:89), are documented verification commands pointing to the local loopback and are ruled out; no other malicious code patterns were detected.

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现安装钩子、代码混淆、凭据读取或外联通道；文档中的 curl 仅为验证步骤，不构成运行时外发。
summary.en: Behavior analysis found no install hooks, code obfuscation, credential reading, or outbound channels; the curl commands in the documentation are only verification steps and do not constitute runtime exfiltration.

summary.zh: 语义审查发现补丁将 Web 服务暴露到 0.0.0.0 并把接口信任围栏扩大到全部局域网 IPv4，形成无鉴权网络暴露面（FND-001，MEDIUM）。
summary.en: Semantic review found that the patch exposes the Web service to 0.0.0.0 and widens the interface trust fence to all LAN IPv4 addresses, forming an unauthenticated network exposure surface (FND-001, MEDIUM).

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙箱产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts).

limits.zh: 动态沙箱未启用（无动态沙箱产物），运行时行为仅基于静态分析；插件无结构化能力声明（安装清单仅含 bundle 补丁声明），能力字段按代码实测推断；未做宿主版本兼容性实测；二进制图片 assets/screenshot-lan-access.jpg 仅做清单校验，未做内容审查。
limits.en: The dynamic sandbox was not enabled (no dynamic sandbox artifacts), so runtime behavior is based only on static analysis; the plugin has no structured capability declaration (the install manifest only contains a bundle patch declaration), so capability fields were inferred from actual code; no host version compatibility testing was performed; the binary image assets/screenshot-lan-access.jpg was only checked against the manifest, no content review was performed.
